description: B36.19 is a standard specification of both seamless and welded stainless steel pipes. The ASME B36.19 Stainless Steel Pipe is used for both high pressures and temperatures as well as for low pressures and temperatures. This stainless steel pipe is used for transporting gases and fluids from one location to the other. We are one of the top ASME B36.19 Stainless Steel Pipe manufacturers in India who focus on creating high-quality products at the most reasonable prices.

The ASTM A312 ASME B36.19m is designed using high graded steel and advanced tools. These pipes with the additions of nickel and chromium can be used in adverse conditions. They are highly resistant to corrosion and erosion. These perform well under extreme temperatures and resist distortion. An ASME B36.19 Pipe has an outside diameter of 4500 mm while a wall thickness of 8.56 mm. These pipes are widely used in chemical industries, aerospace, fertilizer plant, food products, automobiles, thermal and nuclear plants, etc. The ASME b36.19 pressure rating is calculated using a simple equation t = PD/2SE. This is done to check the pressures each pipe can withstand. With pipes being used to transport our food and fuel. checking the pressure a pipe can hold is of utmost importance to prevent unwanted breakage or disruption in livelihood. The ANSI B36.19 Pipe is another pipe that is prepared using materials that are resistant to corrosion and extreme conditions. These are used in heater exchangers, boilers, and condensers. We can cut or groove all our pipes as per your requirements. If you have any queries, regarding our pipes and pricing contact us.
